IsCodeXmlComment.returns: true if an XML comment; otherwise, false.

IsComment.returns: true if a code comment; otherwise, false.

IsDataValue.summary: Check if the text is a Data value.
IsDataValue.returns: true if a data value; otherwise, false.

IsDelimiters.summary: Check if the text contains a common delimiter.
IsDelimiters.returns: true if contains a common delimiter; otherwise, false.

IsParam.summary: Check if the text is a param comment.
IsParam.returns: true if contains a param comment; otherwise, false.

StripQualifier.summary: Strips the leading qualifiers and from next qualifier to end of string.
StripQualifier.param: Set as the number of prefix qualifiers.

CombineTokens.summary: Returns all the combined tokens as a single string.

BeginDelimiter.summary: Gets or sets the default parsing begin delimiter.

CommonDataTypes.summary: Gets or sets the most common Data Types.

CommonKeywords.summary: Gets or sets the most common Keywords.

CommonModifiers.summary: Gets or sets the most common Modifiers.

DataTypes.summary: Gets or sets the additional Data Types.

EndDelimiter.summary: Gets or sets the default parsing end delimiter.

Keywords.summary: Gets or sets the additional Keywords.

LibTypes.summary: Gets or sets the Library Types.

Modifiers.summary: Gets or sets the additional Modifiers.

RefTypes.summary: Gets or sets the Reference types.

Tokens.summary: Gets or sets the token values.

SetKeywords.summary: Sets the Keywords from the previously initialized CodeTokens.

ClearRemainingTokens.summary: Clears all the remaining tokens; starting with the specified token index.

CombineXMLCommentTokens.summary: Combines the tokens for an XMLComment.

EndTokens.summary: Sets the tokenIndex to the end of the tokens array.s

GetNextToken.summary: Gets the next token after the specified token index.

GetToken.summary: Gets the token at the specified token index.

HasBeginDelimiter.summary: Check if the text has the begin delimiter.
HasBeginDelimiter.returns: true if the text has the begin delimiter; otherwise, false.

HasBothDelimiters.summary: Check if the text is a complete XML comment.
HasBothDelimiters.returns: true if the text has both begin delimiters; otherwise, false.

HasEndDelimiter.summary: Check if the text has the end delimiter.
HasEndDelimiter.returns: true if the text has the end begin delimiter; otherwise, false.

IsDataType.summary: Check if the text is a DataType.
IsDataType.param: Indicates if this is the first pass.
IsDataType.returns: true if the text is a data type; otherwise, false.

IsKeyword.summary: Check if the text is a Keyword.
IsKeyword.param: Indicates if this is the first pass.
IsKeyword.returns: true if the text is a keyword; otherwise, false.

IsLibType.summary: Check if the text is a LibType.
IsLibType.returns: true if the text is a common library type; otherwise, false.

IsModifier.summary: Check if the text is a Modifier.
IsModifier.returns: true if the text is a modifier; otherwise, false.

IsRefType.summary: Check if the text is a RefType.
IsRefType.returns: true if the text is a reference type; otherwise, false.

SetTokens.summary: Sets the Tokens value, split on blanks.
